rootCause: Previous metadata rejected alpha.2 before the otherwise matching client contracts could load.
matrixMethod: JSDOM loading each shipped frontend's actual React, SlotCore and primitives; actual registerChatNodeRenderers and current plugin apply; in-memory IndexedDB only.
historicalArtifactIntegrity: 28 npm tarballs verified against registry SHA-512 integrity; alpha.2 used existing local installation.

install.repackNote: Repacked after adding the live-slot verification record; lib/client.js is unchanged (6d738419476fac97a0ae912cae38a12e8eb3789168f4baa31ed948273736aa44), so the installed 0.1.7 client still matches this build.

liveSlotInspection.method: Client Inspect Slots.listSubTree on conversation.chat.reasoning.body, plus plugins.bundle.config seat, on the DSH page already running in the user profile.
liveSlotInspection.note: Proves the 0.1.7 client loaded and replaced the reasoning body slot in the live page; does not prove rendered layout, trusted interaction or passage claiming.

limitations: Not all past/future DSH versions are supported; range is bounded to inspected published versions.
JSDOM is not a real browser and proves no trusted click, keyboard, hover, layout, focus or animation behavior.
Outer chat.node/config seats are statically checked then bridged; full host boot/apply and UI renderer are not started.
Tool/Bash DOM markers are statically checked, not rendered; settings menus and modal are closed.
Display-mode changes, turn-process collapse/reset and virtualization require additional full-browser integration acceptance.
Local tgz installation does not participate in third-party npm update detection; public npm/GitHub/index publishing was not performed.
An unrelated installed dsh-subagent-codex rc.2 remains incompatible with alpha.2 and was not modified.
